regime.label: Rebounding, nerves easing
regime.summary: Fri close: S&P 500 7,297 (+1.6%, +5.6% week), Nasdaq +2.3%, Stoxx 600 643.85 (+1.0%), VIX about 23.8 late (unofficial), 10-year 4.93%. Fed hike Dec 9 nearly fully priced.

brief: US stocks closed the half day +1.6% (S&P 7,297), the best week in more than a year; VIX ended near 23.8 (unofficial). Nothing to buy now: hold Nvidia ($150.49 close), keep the $78.50 SPYM limit; Intuitive Surgical moves from WAIT to WATCH after our red team review.

todo.focus: US closed today (Thanksgiving). No new order. Richemont Friday plan is off.

items.text: Richemont is WAIT: Friday plan cancelled (US proposed a 15% Swiss tariff). Place no CFR order
Nvidia closed $149.30 Wed (-3.9%): HOLD. Huang meets House Dec 1; Senate date not confirmed

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: WAIT. Keep the limit BUY 6 SPYM at $78.50, good till Wed Dec 9. Do not raise it. If not filled after the Fed, a new limit on Dec 10.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. About 3.5% below its high after a -3% month.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. BUY only if the final US text keeps Swiss duty at or below 15%, Hermes makes no new low under its Nov 20 low from Nov 30, and CFR closes at or below CHF 170.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. It closed $319.27, about 3.6% above its 52-week low of $308.22. Reconsider only after 2 closes in a row above $330, then red team first.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), full-year guide raised. About 29% below its high at about 22x next year's profit.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit filled. WATCH on a second slice: no new order until the 2027 capex figure (early Feb) and search growth of at least 12%.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. The Oct 29 profit miss was partly an $8.7B one-off investment loss.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. The rebound is market-wide tariff relief, not company news. Reconsider only after 3 closes in a row above EUR 48.50 and no new US chip export rule.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips, but the cash flow guide is about 20% below hopes. The drop is chip-sector mood.

cards.name: Microsoft
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order now. After the Fed decision (Wed Dec 9): BUY 1 with a limit at $460, only if VIX is below 25 and MSFT has not closed below $440.
cards.story: Revenue grows about 19% with Azure +48%. But bookings fell and capex is about $170B a year, so buy only lower.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. Cancel any old EUR 235 limit. After full-year results (late Feb 2027): BUY 2 at EUR 224 if a cash-flow guide is given.
cards.story: Organic growth +16.9%, record backlog, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal financing, not slower demand.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: WAIT. BUY 1 only after a close above $385, with a limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower. Adds AI-chip exposure.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Intuitive Surgical (da Vinci)
cards.trigger: WATCH. No order, VIX trigger dropped. Reconsider after the Q4 report (late Jan 2027) only if US procedures stop slowing; red team first, $415 is a ceiling.
cards.story: Revenue +22%, but US procedures slowed to +10% and price cuts take 3-5% off instrument revenue by end 2027. About 28% below its high.

cards.name: Texas Instruments
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after the Q4 report (about Jan 26) only if the Q1 guide grows vs Q4 and VIX is below 25; red team first.
cards.story: Fell 11% with Analog Devices' flat outlook. Own numbers are strong (Q3 revenue +28%) but the Q4 guide is flat: mixed.

cards.name: STMicroelectronics · Paris
cards.trigger: WATCH. No order. Reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027) only if the Q1 guide grows, gross margin is at least 39% and distributor stock does not rise.
cards.story: About 48% below its high after the European chip selloff. Q3 sales +17.9%, but growth leans on distributor restocking.

cards.name: SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027) only if current cloud backlog growth stays at 25% or more; red team first.
cards.story: Cloud is fine, but support, licenses and services shrink and SAP guides backlog growth slightly lower. Down about 10% in a month.

cards.name: AI chips: Broadcom, AMD, BESI
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy: each has a company-specific cause and AI-chip exposure is already high. Broadcom: recheck after results Wed Dec 9; red team first.
cards.story: Not clean mood drops: Broadcom has a reported Google TPU order cut, AMD export-rule and share-resale news, BESI a flat Q4 guide.

cards.name: Marvell
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy before results (Tue Dec 1, after close). Recheck Wed Dec 2 after 19:00 Dubai: rocket only if it holds above $145.
cards.story: About 60% below its high. Holding through a binary report could gap far below a stop: it moved -14% on Nov 20 and +18% on Nov 23.

cards.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider from Wed Dec 2 only if VRTX closes above $515 twice in a row (about $534.57 Fri); red team first.
cards.story: FDA delayed its kidney drug decision to Feb 28: a delay, not a rejection. Sales grow 12%, but EPS fell 1% and Trikafta sales fell 8%.

cards.name: Rheinmetall
cards.trigger: AVOID. No buy on the relief rally (+14% in a week). Reconsider only at full-year results if the 2026 guide (about EUR 13.2bn sales, 18.5% margin) is met; red team first.
cards.story: Cut its 2030 targets at the capital markets day, the third cut in a month. Delayed state programmes still weigh.

agenda.event: US markets closed (Thanksgiving); Rheinmetall capital markets day (Nov 26-27)
CrowdStrike, Marvell, Credo (after close); Huang meets House committees; euro-area inflation; US ISM
Senate hearing with Huang requested (date not confirmed)
Comment deadline on the US Section 301 tariff plan
